D-011.rationale: Last-microbatch grad excluded from allreduce; cross-rank param divergence first visible at before-optimizer of next step (== 128's after_optimizer).

D-014.rationale: Ping-pong buffer corruption gives wrong grad values; ~0.3% grad-norm deviation observable post-backward.

D-015.rationale: Optimizer always returns early, params not updated; visible at before-optimizer of next step (params unchanged) and downstream hooks.

D-021.rationale: Stream race produces NaN in reduced grads; manifests in optimizer-state / params after step (== 128's after_optimizer).

D-025.rationale: EP group has 0 members at init due to wrong arg; structurally caught at build.snapshot before any step (matches 128 after_init).

D-026.rationale: MoE grads double-scaled by 1/ep_size; grad-norm anomaly visible after backward.

D-027.rationale: Softmax along wrong dim produces non-normalized coefficients in forward output.

D-029.rationale: CPU-resident grad-norm tensor mis-averaged; deviation visible in post-backward grad-norm value.

D-038.rationale: logical_or on inf produces NaN; clipped grads contain NaN, observable post-backward.

D-040.rationale: Zero-sized microbatches: per-rank loss/activation count differs across DP ranks; first visible at after-forward.

M-005.rationale: Router weights initialized with per-rank RNG; cross-rank checksum mismatch visible at before-forward of step 0 (param-init bug, prompt rule).

M-008.rationale: found_inf_flag stuck true keeps LR at 0; visible in optimizer-state at before-optimizer.

M-010.rationale: save_to_aux_losses_tracker called twice under recompute; doubled aux_loss visible after forward (function-call counting).

M-012.rationale: expert_bias buffer downcast to bf16 by Float16Module; dtype mismatch already present before forward (buffer-state bug).

M-014.rationale: topk-then-softmax with k=1 yields trivial probs == 1.0; routing-prob distribution wrong post-forward.

M-020.rationale: Layer count silently truncated by integer division; structural bug detectable at build.snapshot before step 0.

M-021.rationale: Expert params not in dist-opt buffer; weights unchanged across steps, visible at before-optimizer (== 128 after_optimizer).

M-024.rationale: Uniform jitter in fp32 promotes bf16 input; activation dtype wrong post-forward.

M-033.rationale: Global aux loss missing dp_size factor; grad magnitude 1/dp_size of expected, visible post-backward.

O-002.rationale: attn_norm overwrites residual variable; residual-stream invariance violated in forward output (initial loss spike 10->60).

O-003.rationale: z_loss divided by num_micro_batches not tokens; loss-magnitude check after forward catches it.

O-005.rationale: RNG-state mismatch under checkpointing yields different dropout mask in recompute; grad inconsistency visible post-backward.

O-006.rationale: global_step not reset on resume; dataloader internal start_index wrong post-load. Not visible at the 5 main hooks (cannot tell which sample is 'wrong'); maps to data_loading -> unobservable per brief, recorded under checkpoint_load tap.

O-009.rationale: QK-norm size wrong under GQA; affected normalization stats visible in forward activations (silent, no shape crash).

O-010.rationale: state['step'] never incremented; counter visible directly in optimizer state at before-optimizer.

O-014.rationale: Throughput metrics not all-reduced; cross-rank metric inequality visible post-forward.

O-016.rationale: Missing initial_lr surfaces only after checkpoint resume; per Rule 3 resume-time bugs map to checkpoint_load (visible in optimizer state at next before-optimizer too).

O-021.rationale: Mixture rounding produces sample repetition only at end of training; no hook can tell a sample is 'duplicate' without global bookkeeping. Maps to data_loading -> unobservable per brief.

O-022.rationale: build() corrupts global Python random RNG; observable at build.snapshot (RNG-state tap), not at the 5 main step hooks.

O-023.rationale: label_mask is int64 padded with pad_token_id rather than bool+False; dtype/value wrong on input batch tensor before forward.

O-025.rationale: int overflow in global_train_flops yields anomalous MFU/flops metric at after-forward (after ~107K steps).

O-040.rationale: Wrong A100 peak flops constant inflates MFU 2x; metric anomaly visible at after-forward.

D-001.rationale: Pipeline GAS not averaging grads; grad-norm scales with GAS, visible post-backward (matches 128 after_backward).

D-002.rationale: ZeRO-2 backward regression yields significantly lower grad norm; visible at after-backward.

D-003.rationale: Cross-partition param grads inconsistent across DP ranks after reduce-scatter; cross-rank checksum mismatch post-backward.

D-004.rationale: DistributedAttention SeqAllToAll uneven split produces wrong activation values in forward output (max abs diff ~0.68).

D-005.rationale: CPUAdam bias_correction2 mismatch across subgroups; visible in optimizer state at before-optimizer (== 128 after_optimizer).

D-006.rationale: FusedAdam int32 overflow makes weights unchanged after step; param checksum unchanged across steps, visible at before-optimizer of next step.

D-007.rationale: loss_scale=inf scales grads to NaN; NaN grads observable post-backward.

D-008.rationale: torch.compile RNG-state mismatch yields slow loss divergence over 40K steps; no single-step hook can reliably distinguish buggy from clean (multi-step convergence regression).

D-009.rationale: ZeRO-3 overwrites custom expert .id at deepspeed.initialize(); structural attribute mismatch caught at build.snapshot before any step.

D-010.rationale: Multi-backward grads dropped under CPU offload; param deviation ~2x lr visible after step at before-optimizer of next step (== 128 after_optimizer).

D-012.rationale: CPU offload drops grads at micro_step_id>0; grad norm frozen instead of accumulating, observable post-backward.

D-013.rationale: bf16+ZeRO0 grads not zeroed and mis-scaled; grad-norm anomaly visible post-backward (manifests before optimizer).

D-016.rationale: CPU offload grad clipping records stale norm_for_param_grads; logged grad_norm vs actual grad mismatch post-backward.

D-017.rationale: micro_step_id init mismatch causes grad copy when accumulation expected; grad value discontinuity visible post-backward.

D-018.rationale: MoE param _hp_mapping=None due to wrong DP world_size at link_all_hp_params during init; structural mismatch caught at build.snapshot (== 128 after_init).

D-019.rationale: MoE EP grad scale off by ep_size and partitioned by wrong DP group; grad-norm and cross-EP-rank inequality post-backward.

D-020.rationale: LayerNorm CUDA backward kernel uses wrong index for gamma grad; gamma grad checksum diverges from reference post-backward.

D-022.rationale: Universal-checkpoint conversion sorts shard files lexicographically; corrupted optimizer state surfaces at checkpoint_load tap.

D-023.rationale: CPUAdam mixes mul vs recompute path across subgroups; bias-correction metadata mismatch visible directly in optimizer state at before-optimizer.

D-024.rationale: ds_secondary_tensor stale after checkpoint load; cksum vs ds_tensor mismatch at checkpoint_load tap, abnormally high loss in next forward.

D-028.rationale: BF16+ZeRO0 allreduces BF16 grads instead of FP32 buffer; collective dtype mismatch observable during backward main-grad accumulation.

D-030.rationale: ZeRO-3 ignores configured comm dtype for all-gather/reduce-scatter; collective dtype mismatch during backward.

D-031.rationale: MoE gate.wg grads not captured by ZeRO-2 hook; gate grad missing/cross-rank inequal post-backward.

D-032.rationale: Stage3 universal-ckpt multi-machine load corrupted; abnormal post-resume loss surfaces at checkpoint_load tap.

D-033.rationale: bf16+ZeRO0 wrong flag drops optimizer state on load; step counter / exp_avg zeroed, observable at checkpoint_load and before-optimizer.

D-034.rationale: SP grads scaled by global world_size and reduced in BF16; grad-norm pattern wrong post-backward, growing across steps.

D-035.rationale: ZeRO-3 grad norm not allreduced across DP; grad norm differs across DP ranks, observable post-backward.

D-036.rationale: bf16 optimizer step doesn't cast grad to FP32 when grad_accum dtype differs; dtype mismatch in optimizer-state inputs at before-optimizer (== 128 after_optimizer).

D-037.rationale: Gate cast to fp32 inside forward (breaks ZeRO buffer view) and top-2 aux loss off by num_experts; param dtype change & loss anomaly visible post-forward.

D-039.rationale: reduce_bucket_size affects training convergence; loss/grad-norm changes with bucket size, visible after backward.

D-041.rationale: ckpt directory name vs internal global_step mismatch detected at save; equality check at checkpoint_save tap.

D-042.rationale: Coalesced all-gather under autocast mixes dtypes; param state tracking error first manifests in forward (AVAILABLE/inflight invariant).

D-043.rationale: MiCS only first partition group writes ckpt; missing files caught at checkpoint_save completeness tap.

D-044.rationale: Stage3 universal-ckpt multi-subgroup tensor-slice OOB and write race; corruption surfaces at checkpoint_save.

D-045.rationale: ZeRO grad-accum buffer forced to BF16 not FP32; dtype invariant on accumulation buffer wrong during backward.

D-046.rationale: MoE TP>1 saves only rank-0 model_states; missing per-TP-rank files caught at checkpoint_save completeness.

M-001.rationale: Embedding grads reduce-scattered before PP all-reduce; PP[0] vs PP[-1] embedding grad checksum diverges post-backward.

M-002.rationale: CP attention backward dQ/dK/dV relative error >1.0 vs single-GPU reference; grad anomaly visible post-backward.

M-003.rationale: CP backward multiplies loss by cp_size; grads scaled by cp_size factor, observable after backward.

M-004.rationale: MTP loss not divided by num_tokens; .sum().backward() instead of mean causes grad-norm spike post-backward.

M-006.rationale: TP with non-divisible vocab: uneven split causes systematic loss divergence; loss-formation anomaly post-forward.

M-007.rationale: overlap-param-gather bucket order mismatch leaves stale weights; param checksum on some ranks matches previous iter at before-forward.

M-009.rationale: SP+FlashAttn skips q/k/v all-gather; attention computed only on local chunk, output deviates from reference post-forward.

M-011.rationale: RoPE ignores reset-position-ids; positional encoding tensor wrong inside forward, observable in activations post-forward.

M-013.rationale: seq_aux_loss with pad_to_capacity yields constant 1.0 aux loss; loss-formation invariant violated post-forward.

M-015.rationale: override-opt_param-scheduler ignored on resume; old max_lr/min_lr persist in param_group, surfaces at checkpoint_load and at before-optimizer of next step.

M-016.rationale: Optimizer offload ckpt resume corrupts optimizer state (loss 0.31->10); manifests at checkpoint_load.

M-017.rationale: mcore-0.12 ckpt resume can't reproduce loss; optimizer/RNG state mismatch surfaces at checkpoint_load.

M-018.rationale: RNG state inconsistent across DP ranks vs docstring; cross-DP dropout-mask mismatch observable in forward activations.

M-019.rationale: Embedding wgrad finished after PP all-reduce; final embedding grad excluded from sync, cross-rank inequality post-backward.

M-022.rationale: MLA softmax_factor uses mscale instead of mscale_all_dim; attention scaling wrong inside forward, output deviates.

M-023.rationale: PP get_tensor_shapes ignores CP size; PP p2p tensor shapes inconsistent with activation shapes, exposed in forward.

M-025.rationale: Master weights init via cast instead of direct params_dtype; param-init dtype/value bug visible at before-forward of step 0 (param-init rule).

M-026.rationale: Multi-stream race lets DDP read uninitialized params into buckets; cross-rank param-init checksum mismatch observable at before-forward of step 0.

M-027.rationale: int32 overflow in sample_idx silently feeds wrong samples; data-loading bug — no hook can detect that 'this sample is wrong' (per brief, data_loading -> unobservable).

M-028.rationale: RoPE CP split mis-assigns sin/cos to ranks; positional encoding wrong per CP rank, observable in forward activations.

M-029.rationale: torch.compile recompile-limit hit breaks autograd; broadcast_ silently produces wrong grads, post-backward cross-rank mismatch.

M-030.rationale: First step after resume uses old LR despite override; LR-schedule state wrong on load, visible at checkpoint_load and before-optimizer.

M-031.rationale: MXFP8 grad-buffer reuse without overlap corrupts buffer mid-collective; NaN/dtype anomaly during backward main-grad accumulation.

M-032.rationale: MLA forward produces abnormal loss values vs non-MLA reference; loss-formation deviation post-forward.

M-034.rationale: DDP post-hook on side stream lets reduce-scatter race; cross-DP grad checksum mismatch post-backward.

M-035.rationale: TE fused_attn_bwd dQ relative error >1.0 for deep models; grad-norm anomaly post-backward.

M-036.rationale: TE silently uses causal mask, ignoring block-diagonal mask for packed sequences; cross-document attention leakage observable in forward output.

M-037.rationale: YarnRotaryEmbedding lacks rotary_interleaved forwarding; RoPE freq-format mismatch corrupts positional encoding inside forward.

M-038.rationale: MTPLossAutoScaler doesn't compensate cp_size factor; MTP grad scaled down by cp_size, visible post-backward.

M-039.rationale: MoE gate not sliced when kv_head<tp_size; gate weight identical across TP ranks (should differ), cross-TP-rank shape/cksum check at before-forward.

M-040.rationale: finish_param_sync skipped on first iter so grad buffer not zeroed; non-zero buffer pollutes main-grad accumulation, visible during backward.

M-041.rationale: FlashSelfAttention permanently sets dropout_p=0 after eval; activation variance shifts, visible post-forward.

M-042.rationale: Optimizer state dict missing exp_avg at save-interval=20; completeness check at checkpoint_save tap.

O-001.rationale: Sequential block shares LayerNorm between attn and FFN paths; coupled norm outputs observable in forward activations.

O-004.rationale: FSDP reduce_dtype=bf16 causes output-logit-norm linear growth at >4 nodes; multi-step convergence regression — single-step hooks see only sub-noise diff.

O-007.rationale: flash-attn API rename ignore_index unrecognized; padding tokens contribute to loss, loss-formation invariant violated post-forward.

O-008.rationale: Unsharded ckpt save corrupts state; manifests at checkpoint_save (incomplete state) and at checkpoint_load when resuming.

O-011.rationale: CP blocks reuse identical RoPE buffers across blocks; cross-block buffer-equality anomaly observable in forward activations.

O-012.rationale: TP fused_linear loss treats ce_loss/z_loss as distributed instead of local; loss value differs from non-TP reference post-forward.

O-013.rationale: Fused CE loss buggy and consistently underperforms native PyTorch CE; loss-formation deviation post-forward.

O-015.rationale: Instance mask all-zero divides by zero; NaN loss value visible post-forward.

O-017.rationale: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler init wrong; LR value in param_group differs from configured schedule, visible at before-optimizer.

O-018.rationale: Fine-grained FSDP wrap + activation-checkpoint interaction yields wrong fwd/bwd; deviation surfaces in grads post-backward (per check_stage).

O-019.rationale: LM-evaluator data-order drift across runs due to bookkeeping reset; data_loading bug — no hook can tell sample order is wrong (per brief).

O-020.rationale: SourceMixtureDataset truncates instead of random-sampling; data_loading bug — no hook detects wrong sample distribution at runtime (per brief).

O-024.rationale: Depth-scaled output-projection init never applied due to self-equality bug; per-layer init scale wrong, param-init checksum at before-forward of step 0 (matches 128 after_init).

O-026.rationale: FSDP FULL_SHARD silently ignores load_state_dict between fwd/bwd; ckpt-load no-op caught at checkpoint_load tap.

O-027.rationale: torch.compile CSE eliminates expression after fsdp.set_; result differs from eager mode, visible in forward output.

O-028.rationale: FSDP eval() leaves some params in bf16; SDPA receives mixed-dtype input, dtype invariant violated in forward.

O-029.rationale: FSDP+CPU offload accumulation outside no_sync overwrites grads instead of summing; grad-accum anomaly post-backward.

O-030.rationale: FSDP+PP zero-bubble bypasses _root_post_backward_final_callback; reduce-scatter races with grad read, post-backward inconsistency.

O-031.rationale: FP32-vs-BF16 grad accumulation in FSDP causes large-scale (>100 GPU) instability; multi-step convergence regression — single-step grad delta within noise.

O-032.rationale: Gradient-clip epsilon added per-rank instead of once; clip_coef varies with world size, visible post-backward.

O-033.rationale: FSDP use_orig_params + FULL_SHARD inner-module state_dict missing params; key-set completeness check at checkpoint_save.

O-034.rationale: FSDPv2 _pre_forward dtype cast is skipped during recomputation; bf16/fp32 mismatch first manifests when activations are produced in forward and persists through the backward recomputation path.

O-035.rationale: param_init_fn + sync_module_states diverges parameter values across ranks at init; cross-rank param checksum at the first before-forward hook reveals the divergence.

O-036.rationale: Meta-device init produces parameters that differ from direct GPU init; the discrepancy is present from before-forward of step 1 onward.

O-037.rationale: Block-level FSDP wrapping introduces gradient precision loss inside backward; activation/grad numerical drift first appears at after-forward and grows during backward.

O-038.rationale: Grad-norm scaling uses world_size instead of DP size; the wrong scaling becomes visible only after backward when the global grad norm is computed.

O-039.rationale: Duplicate-final-checkpoint write happens during save; only the checkpoint.save tap can observe the duplicate write and overwrite.

B1.rationale: Router weight is RNG-divergent across TP ranks at construction; cross-rank param hash at before-forward of step 1 reveals it and the divergence persists every hook.

B10.rationale: micro_step_id off-by-one is only diagnosable as a counter mismatch at the GAS boundary right before optimizer.step.

B11.rationale: max-instead-of-min in clip_coef leaves grad norm unclipped; observable only after grad clipping runs (after-backward) by checking ||grad|| <= max_norm.

B12.rationale: Missing initial_lr key on param_groups is a structural property of the optimizer state, only checkable at before-optimizer.

B13.rationale: attn_norm clobbering the residual stream changes forward outputs; activation-level invariant fails at after-forward.

B14.rationale: Wrong masked-mean for z-loss is a forward-pass numerical bug; the loss formed in forward differs from reference at after-forward.

B15.rationale: Dividing z-loss by num_micro_batches instead of token count corrupts the loss value formed in forward; observable at after-forward.

B2.rationale: grad_input is missing TP all-reduce; magnitude check vs N*local_grad fails after the backward pass completes (i.e., after-backward).

B3.rationale: communication_data_type defaults to fp32 when only bf16 is enabled; the dtype anomaly first surfaces during backward grad reduction.

B4.rationale: Wrong DP src rank routes gradient broadcasts/all-reduces to the wrong root; the rank-mapping anomaly is first detectable when the collective fires during backward.

B5.rationale: finish_grad_sync forgets to scale expert_grads by 1/dp; the missing divide is observable post-grad-sync, i.e. after-backward.

B6.rationale: param_sync_microbatch_id gate compares against wrong total; the counter mismatch (number of param_sync invocations) is checkable only at before-optimizer of the global step.

B7.rationale: FlashSelfAttention.dropout_p is permanently mutated to 0 after a forward in eval mode; attribute drift is visible at the next after-forward and persists.

B8.rationale: EP group is constructed with num_experts instead of ep_size during InferenceEngine.__init__; the malformed group is observable at build/snapshot before any step.

B9.rationale: Wrong all-to-all branch is taken on second all2all in sequence-parallel forward; the corrupted activation routing is first observable at after-forward.

D-NEW-1.rationale: Topk on logits vs post-softmax gates: softmax is monotonic so topk indices are identical; only the gate weights differ subtly with no observable runtime hook signal.

D-NEW-12.rationale: Config-key typo causes the user-set seq_parallel_communication_data_type to be silently ignored; the wrong parsed config is observable at build snapshot.

D-NEW-13.rationale: CPU offload only accumulates grads into the CPU buffer when ga_steps>1, so on micro-step boundaries the CPU grad buffer underestimates the norm; observable post-grad-sync.

D-NEW-14.rationale: WarmupCosineLR multi-group get_lr returns a wrong-length list; the schedule output mismatches param_groups, observable at before-optimizer.

D-NEW-15.rationale: BF16+ZeRO0 path skips zero_grad after each step; from step 2 onward, param.grad is non-zero at before-forward and remains visible every subsequent hook.

D-NEW-16.rationale: Wrong stream sync (default vs current) for reduce_and_partition_stream causes a race during grad reduction; the corrupted reduction shows up during/after backward.

D-NEW-17.rationale: Loss double-scaling applied to gas_scaled_loss inflates gradient magnitudes; observable as grad-norm anomaly post-backward.

D-NEW-18.rationale: ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload mishandles multiple backward() per step, dropping grad contributions; the missing accumulation is detectable post-grad-sync.

D-NEW-19.rationale: extra_large_param uses param.dtype not comm_dtype, so its grad is silently dropped from reduction; absence of expected grad surfaces after grad-sync completes.

D-NEW-2.rationale: WarmupCosineLR returns a scalar not a per-group list; structural mismatch with optimizer.param_groups visible at before-optimizer.

D-NEW-20.rationale: Wrong optimizer class (BF16_Optimizer for bf16+fp32_grad_accum without ZeRO) selected at engine init; observable at build snapshot.

D-NEW-21.rationale: bf16-without-ZeRO path mistakenly writes ZeRO optimizer state into the checkpoint; observable at the checkpoint.save tap and again at load.

D-NEW-22.rationale: ZeRO 1/2 elastic checkpoint alignment mismatch: optimizer.state[p] after load != pre-save tensor; observable at checkpoint_load and persists.

D-NEW-23.rationale: allreduce_bucket forces rank=None; the call uses dist.all_reduce instead of dist.reduce. Function-call counting at the all_reduce tap during backward catches it.

D-NEW-24.rationale: Off-by-one in contiguous IPG bucket comparison drops the gradient of a param exactly filling the bucket; missing reduced grad on the owning rank is visible post-grad-sync.

D-NEW-25.rationale: load_module_only with bf16 skips refresh_fp32_params; uninitialized fp32 master weights are observable at checkpoint_load and persist into every following hook.

D-NEW-26.rationale: Copy-paste typo writes config flag into wrong attribute during zero.Init; the attribute mismatch is observable at the build/init snapshot.

D-NEW-27.rationale: Inverted dtype gate inside __avg_scatter_contiguous_grads sends the wrong-dtype tensor into reduce_scatter; the dtype invariant fires at the collective during backward.

D-NEW-28.rationale: Two-bug combo: wrong optimizer dispatch + extra_large_param uses raw param.grad. Both lead to grad-tensor mismatch detectable post-grad-sync.

D-NEW-29.rationale: fp32->fp16 master copy uses outer-loop partition_id, writing to wrong rank's slice in MoE groups; cross-rank bit16 partition mismatch is observable right after step (before-optimizer of next step / before-forward).

D-NEW-3.rationale: Frozen params accidentally included in optimizer.param_groups; structural invariant 'all params requires_grad=True' checkable at build snapshot.

D-NEW-30.rationale: DeepSpeedCPUAdam fp32->fp16 partition_id wrong across groups; bit16 partitions mismatch their fp32 sources, visible right at/after the step boundary.

D-NEW-31.rationale: param_to_partition_ids built from non-reordered group while reduction uses round_robin order; partition-owner mismatch is detectable when reduction completes (after-backward).

D-NEW-32.rationale: partition_balanced returns degenerate boundaries assigning a PP stage zero layers; observable at module-construction time, i.e., build snapshot.

D-NEW-33.rationale: MiCS: every rank writes the non-ZeRO checkpoint, racing on the same file; observable only at checkpoint_save (function-call counting on save).

D-NEW-34.rationale: all_gather_coalesced hardcodes ds_tensor dtype, mixing dtypes silently truncates buffers; the corrupted allgather corrupts params just before forward use, surfacing through forward/backward use and the allgather byte-count check.

D-NEW-35.rationale: Train and eval coordinators share an InflightParamRegistry; structural identity check (registry is not the same Python object) is visible at every hook starting from before-forward.

D-NEW-36.rationale: Unscale of grad norm uses post-decay loss_scale instead of prev_scale; mismatch (_global_grad_norm * prev_scale != scaled_global_grad_norm) is checkable at before-optimizer.

D-NEW-38.rationale: Sparse grad path rebinds local var instead of writing to param.grad; param.grad fails to reflect all-reduced values, observable post-grad-sync.

D-NEW-39.rationale: Pipeline _aggregate_total_loss broadcasts mixed-dtype loss; non-last PP stages receive wrong-dtype tensor when the aggregated loss is formed (after-forward).

D-NEW-40.rationale: zero_wrapper_for_fp_tensor_constructor reassigns Parameter to non-Parameter Tensor at construction; param identity/dtype invariants fail at build snapshot.

D-NEW-42.rationale: ZeRO3 checkpoint omits frozen params from saved state; observable at checkpoint_save (save manifest missing entries) and again at load.

D-NEW-43.rationale: fp16 partitions built from full param_groups including frozen params; structural invariant (frozen p.data unchanged across steps) and OOM-equivalent waste are visible from build onward.

D-NEW-44.rationale: MoE save_checkpoint with TP>1 only writes mp_rank_00 model_states.pt; missing files are observable via function-call counting on checkpoint_save.

D-NEW-45.rationale: Backward-hook closure captures stale group index `i`; gradients route to wrong reduction bucket as backward fires hooks (main-grad-in-backward).

D-NEW-46.rationale: Inner optimizer.step() called once during init increments Adam state['step']; observable at build snapshot (state['step'] != 0 before any real backward).

D-NEW-47.rationale: Auto-selected fp32 grad_accum_dtype mismatches bf16 model under ZeRO; the engine config invariant (grad_accum_dtype == model_dtype when ZeRO) fails at build/init.

D-NEW-48.rationale: GAS-boundary flag never propagated to ZeRO; ZeRO reduces every micro-step. Function-call counting on the all_reduce tap during backward catches the extra reductions.

D-NEW-49.rationale: DeepSpeedDataLoader.__len__ returns sample count not batch count; observable at build snapshot via len(dataloader) check.

D-NEW-50.rationale: fp32_groups_gradients_flat allocated as fp32 ignoring grad_acc_dtype; dtype invariant fails at build snapshot, and bad reduction dtype manifests during backward.

D-NEW-51.rationale: extra_large_param_to_reduce reference leaks across steps when contiguous_gradients=False; structural invariant (must be None) checkable at before-forward of step 2 onward.

D-NEW-53.rationale: AutoEP forgets ep_size loss scaling; expert grads under-scaled, observable as cross-config (DP=N,EP=1 vs DP=N/ep,EP=ep) post-step weight divergence at before-optimizer of the next step.

D-NEW-54.rationale: MoE checkpoint records dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size; the wrong replication factor is written at save and breaks load.

D-NEW-55.rationale: ZeRO-1/2 expert grads pre-divide by edp_world_size then skip bucket-final divide; net divisor wrong, observable as expert-grad ratio anomaly post-grad-sync.

D-NEW-56.rationale: topkgating drop_tokens=False uses stale `locations` after capacity update; dispatch positions wrong inside forward, observable at after-forward.

D-NEW-57.rationale: ZeRO++ ds_secondary_tensor stale after load/resume; the dirty allgather corrupts the next forward — first observable at before-forward (post-load) and at after-forward.

D-NEW-58.rationale: Asymmetric int8 dequantize hardcodes __half output; precision loss enters activations during forward and propagates.

D-NEW-59.rationale: Hardcoded gpu_per_node=16 inside quantized_reduction; wrong intra-node split during grad reduction produces incorrect reduced grads in backward.

D-NEW-60.rationale: Universal checkpoint stage3 multi-machine load uses local_rank instead of global DP rank; wrong partition slice loaded at checkpoint_load and persists.

D-NEW-61.rationale: ZeRO-1 fp16 overflow flag broadcast guarded by partition_gradients; ranks disagree on overflow/loss_scale, observable post-backward at the loss-scale-update point.

D-NEW-62.rationale: BF16_Optimizer skips fp32 cast of grad when grad_acc_dtype != fp32; dtype invariant (param_partition.grad dtype == fp32 inside step) fails right at before-optimizer.

D-NEW-63.rationale: CPUAdam IncrementStep non-idempotent across same-step subgroup updates; bias-correction drift between subgroups is visible at before-optimizer / inside the step.

D-NEW-64.rationale: FP16 fused optimizer global_grad_norm undercounted by sqrt(tp_size); observable post-backward at the grad_norm computation point.

D-NEW-65.rationale: PipelineEngine non-last-stage backward double-updates hp_grads with bf16 immediate-update; fp32 grad updated twice, magnitude anomaly visible after backward.

D-NEW-66.rationale: ZeRO-3 CPU offload set_local_grad doesn't refresh norm_for_param_grads; grad clipping uses stale norm, observable when grad_norm is recomputed at before-optimizer.
